verdict.rationale: mise ships its own registry of 1,000+ tools with shorthands and search. Its backends reach npm, PyPI via pipx, cargo, GitHub releases, aqua and Homebrew formulae, and docs say github/aqua give access to almost all programs on GitHub. Community users confirm 'many more package sources' and praise the release frequency, and registry data can be pulled fresh independent of the mise binary. Missing for 10: explicit first-party evidence of the registry's maintenance cadence or contribution process.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install almost anything I need from a large, actively maintained package registry or repository

citations.quote: Install any of 1,000+ tools, choose a version for each project
github and aqua give you for example access to almost all programs available on GitHub.
A backend is where mise installs a tool from: a package registry such as npm or cargo, a release host such as GitHub, or a plugin.
mise has its own Homebrew implementation, so it installs formulae and casks without requiring Homebrew.
Users whose system package manager ships mise updates slowly can opt in to current registry data without replacing the mise executable
It allows many more package sources (including pipx, go and cargo).
